title: Evaluation preserves the Isom-to-Hom projection
statement: Let X be a scheme, B a commutative ring, A,D objects of D(X_et,B), U an affine weakly contractible pro-etale object [sk-def-pe-weak-contractible], and s a section of the comparison pullback of the local Isom sheaf [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf]. Apply the sheafified Isom-to-Hom projection to s and evaluate using the local Hom comparison [def-weil-pbc-derived-morphism-sheaf-comparison]. The resulting morphism equals the underlying morphism of the evaluated local isomorphism.

proof.text: The local comparison map sends the underlying arrow of an isomorphism to the underlying arrow of its image. Transpose this identity under the sheafification/comparison adjunction to relate the two sheaf comparisons.
Apply naturality of the pro-etale sheafification unit to Isom-to-Hom. Its inverse-unit equations identify the evaluated morphisms, by injectivity of the Hom unit on U.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedIsoEvaluation_hom
    (U : X.ProEt) [IsAffine U.left]
    (hw : (ProEt.topology X).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} U)
    (s : ((comparisonSetUpperStar X).obj
      (derivedLocalIsoSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B A D)).obj.obj (op U)) :
    derivedHomEvaluation X B A D U hw
        (((comparisonSetUpperStar X).map
          ((presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).map
            (derivedLocalIsoToHomPresheaf (J := X.smallEtaleTopology) (B := B)
              (A := A) (D := D)))).hom.app (op U) s) =
      (derivedIsoEvaluation X B A D U hw s).hom
